sentences.text_target: Tom arrives at the office very early today.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm əˈraɪvz æt ði ˈɒfɪs ˈvɛri ˈɜːli təˈdeɪ/
sentences.text_native: Tom arrive au bureau très tôt aujourd'hui.

sentences.text_target: He wears a nice grey suit and brown shoes.
sentences.phonetic: /hi wɛəz ə naɪs greɪ suːt ænd braʊn ʃuːz/
sentences.text_native: Il porte un beau costume gris et des chaussures marron.

sentences.text_target: He carries a heavy black leather bag.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ˈkæriz ə ˈhɛvi blæk ˈlɛðə bæg/
sentences.text_native: Il porte un lourd sac en cuir noir.

sentences.text_target: Inside the bag, his computer and papers are ready.
sentences.phonetic: /ɪnˈsaɪd ðə bæg, hɪz kəmˈpjuːtə ænd ˈpeɪpəz ɑːr ˈrɛdi/
sentences.text_native: À l'intérieur du sac, son ordinateur et ses papiers sont prêts.

sentences.text_target: He waits quietly in the small corridor outside.
sentences.phonetic: /hi weɪts ˈkwaɪətli ɪn ðə smɔːl ˈkɒrɪdɔːr ˈaʊtˈsaɪd/
sentences.text_native: Il attend tranquillement dans le petit couloir à l'extérieur.

sentences.text_target: He feels a little nervous before the meeting.
sentences.phonetic: /hi fiːlz ə ˈlɪtl ˈnɜːvəs bɪˈfɔː ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: Il se sent un peu nerveux avant la réunion.

sentences.text_target: He takes a deep breath to calm down.
sentences.phonetic: /hi teɪks ə diːp brɛθ tuː kɑːm daʊn/
sentences.text_native: Il prend une grande inspiration pour se calmer.

sentences.text_target: At nine o'clock, he opens the meeting room door.
sentences.phonetic: /æt naɪn əˈklɒk, hi ˈəʊpənz ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ ruːm dɔː/
sentences.text_native: À neuf heures, il ouvre la porte de la salle de réunion.

sentences.text_target: His colleagues are already sitting at the long table.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz ˈkɒliːgz ɑːr ɔːlˈrɛdi ˈsɪtɪŋ æt ðə lɒŋ ˈteɪbl/
sentences.text_native: Ses collègues sont déjà assis à la longue table.

sentences.text_target: Tom walks to the front of the room.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm wɔːks tuː ðə frʌnt ɒv ðə ruːm/
sentences.text_native: Tom marche vers l'avant de la pièce.

sentences.text_target: He puts his folder carefully on the desk.
sentences.phonetic: /hi pʊts hɪz ˈfəʊldə ˈkeəfʊli ɒn ðə dɛsk/
sentences.text_native: Il pose son dossier soigneusement sur le bureau.

sentences.text_target: He connects his laptop to the big screen.
sentences.phonetic: /hi kəˈnɛkts hɪz ˈlæptɒp tuː ðə bɪg skriːn/
sentences.text_native: Il connecte son ordinateur portable au grand écran.

sentences.text_target: The projector turns on and shows the first slide.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə prəˈʤɛktə tɜːnz ɒn ænd ʃəʊz ðə fɜːst slaɪd/
sentences.text_native: Le projecteur s'allume et montre la première diapositive.

sentences.text_target: He tests the small microphone on his shirt.
sentences.phonetic: /hi tɛsts ðə smɔːl ˈmaɪkrəfəʊn ɒn hɪz ʃɜːt/
sentences.text_native: Il teste le petit microphone sur sa chemise.

sentences.text_target: Everyone looks at him with a warm smile.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɛvrɪwʌn lʊks æt hɪm wɪð ə wɔːm smaɪl/
sentences.text_native: Tout le monde le regarde avec un sourire chaleureux.

sentences.text_target: Tom starts to speak in a clear voice.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm stɑːts tuː spiːk ɪn ə klɪə vɔɪs/
sentences.text_native: Tom commence à parler d'une voix claire.

sentences.text_target: He explains the new business plan very slowly.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ɪksˈpleɪnz ðə njuː ˈbɪznɪs plæn ˈvɛri ˈsləʊli/
sentences.text_native: Il explique le nouveau plan d'affaires très lentement.

sentences.text_target: He uses a black clicker to change the pages.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ˈjuːzɪz ə blæk ˈklɪkə tuː ʧeɪnʤ ðə ˈpeɪʤɪz/
sentences.text_native: Il utilise une télécommande noire pour changer les pages.

sentences.text_target: He points a red laser at important numbers.
sentences.phonetic: /hi pɔɪnts ə rɛd ˈleɪzə æt ɪmˈpɔːtənt ˈnʌmbəz/
sentences.text_native: Il pointe un laser rouge sur les chiffres importants.

sentences.text_target: The people in the room listen with great attention.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈpiːpl ɪn ðə ruːm ˈlɪsn wɪð greɪt əˈtɛnʃn/
sentences.text_native: Les gens dans la pièce écoutent avec beaucoup d'attention.

sentences.text_target: He gives a concrete example for every project.
sentences.phonetic: /hi gɪvz ə ˈkɒŋkriːt ɪgˈzɑːmpl fɔːr ˈɛvri ˈprɒʤɛkt/
sentences.text_native: Il donne un exemple concret pour chaque projet.

sentences.text_target: His friends in the audience nod their heads.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz frɛndz ɪn ði ˈɔːdiəns nɒd ðeə hɛdz/
sentences.text_native: Ses collègues dans le public hochent la tête.

sentences.text_target: After twenty minutes, he drinks some fresh water.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɑːftə ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts, hi drɪŋks sʌm frɛʃ ˈwɔːtə/
sentences.text_native: Après vingt minutes, il boit de l'eau fraîche.

sentences.text_target: Then he answers many questions from his boss.
sentences.phonetic: /ðɛn hi ˈɑːnsəz ˈmɛni ˈkwɛstʃənz frɒm hɪz bɒs/
sentences.text_native: Ensuite, il répond à de nombreuses questions de son patron.

sentences.text_target: Everybody understands the message very well.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɛvribɒdi ˌʌndəˈstændz ðə ˈmɛsɪʤ ˈvɛri wɛl/
sentences.text_native: Tout le monde comprend très bien le message.

sentences.text_target: Tom finishes his presentation with a happy smile.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm ˈfɪnɪʃɪz hɪz ˌprɛzənˈteɪʃn wɪð ə ˈhæpi smaɪl/
sentences.text_native: Tom termine sa présentation avec un sourire heureux.

sentences.text_target: All colleagues stand up and clap their hands.
sentences.phonetic: /ɔːl ˈkɒliːgz stænd ʌp ænd klæp ðeə hændz/
sentences.text_native: Tous les collègues se lèvent et applaudissent.

sentences.text_target: He says thank you to everyone in the room.
sentences.phonetic: /hi seɪz θæŋk juː tuː ˈɛvrɪwʌn ɪn ðə ruːm/
sentences.text_native: Il dit merci à tout le monde dans la pièce.

sentences.text_target: It is a big success for his daily job.
sentences.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ə bɪg səkˈsɛs fɔː hɪz ˈdeɪli ʤɒb/
sentences.text_native: C'est un grand succès pour son travail quotidien.

sentences.text_target: He goes back to his seat feeling very proud.
sentences.phonetic: /hi gəʊz bæk tuː hɪz siːt ˈfiːlɪŋ ˈvɛri praʊd/
sentences.text_native: Il retourne à sa place en se sentant très fier.
